reason: R699 a month is not the problem. A brand-new company with no restaurant live yet, asking me to be a pilot while my waiters still ring everything up on the POS, means I would pay for a second order system and still type the orders in twice on the busiest nights.
objection: Will it work with my POS, or will my staff have to type orders in twice? Until the POS link exists I am not solving my slow-service problem, I am adding work.
would_change_my_mind: A working direct link to my POS, or two or three live restaurants of my kind that show orders going straight to the kitchen screen without double entry.
